instruction: Look at dome_pocket.step in NX CAM. Create Cavity Mill or adaptive roughing for dome_pocket.step, then finish the spherical region using ball-end surface finishing. Roughing must leave 0.3 mm stock and finishing must target zero stock. Tool definitions: T1 is a 10 mm end mill for Cavity Mill/adaptive roughing leaving 0.3 mm stock; T2 is a 6 mm ball end mill for surface finishing. Write the required output file(s) using exactly these Desktop path(s): C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-15.nc.
